### Understanding 5. Capstone Project & Production Deployment

In this lesson, we explore the fundamental mechanics, theoretical guarantees, and practical engineering applications of **5. Capstone Project & Production Deployment**.

3. Common edge cases and defensive patterns
4. Real-world industry benchmarks and applications
